content.value_statement: Implementation teams need reliable review before merge. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured readiness checks.
actual_capabilities: Shows when to request code review during task, feature, and merge workflows.
Provides git commands for selecting base and head revisions.
Directs use of a code-reviewer subagent template.
Structures review output into strengths, issues, recommendations, and merge readiness.
Defines severity levels for Critical, Important, and Minor feedback.
limitations: It does not run tests or inspect code without an AI agent using the template.
It depends on accurate base and head revisions from the repository.
It cannot replace human ownership for production risk decisions.
It is tailored to git-based workflows and subagent review patterns.

use_cases.title: Review a Completed Task
use_cases.description: Check a finished development task before starting the next task in a plan.

use_cases.title: Validate a Feature Before Merge
use_cases.description: Compare a major feature against requirements and identify blocking issues before merge.

use_cases.title: Strengthen Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Use a consistent review checklist to assess bugs, tests, documentation, and compatibility.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Latest Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request after a small task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my latest completed task before I continue. Compare it with the requirement and give a clear readiness verdict.

prompt_templates.title: Check Feature Completion
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for a larger feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feature against the plan. Categorize issues by severity and note what must change before merge.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Pre-Merge Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before merging to main.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the selected git range for production readiness. Focus on correctness, tests, architecture, security, and breaking changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Multi-Step Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review after several planned tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the completed batch of tasks against the implementation plan. Identify compounded risks and decide whether work should continue.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for review after finishing a verification feature.
output: Strengths: The implementation has clear separation of responsibilities and meaningful tests.
Important issue: Progress feedback is missing for long operations.
Assessment: Ready to continue after the important issue is fixed.

output_examples.input: A team lead requests a review before merging a new workflow.
output: Strengths: The workflow follows the plan and keeps compatibility requirements visible.
Critical issue: One failure path can skip required cleanup.
Assessment: Not ready to merge until the cleanup path is fixed and tested.

output_examples.input: A release engineer asks for a readiness review after several tasks.
output: Strengths: Tests cover the main success path and several edge cases.
Minor issue: Documentation should mention the new review checkpoint.
Assessment: Ready with a documentation follow-up.

best_practices: Request review after each meaningful task, not only at the end of a project.
Provide accurate requirements and git revisions so the reviewer can compare intent with implementation.
Fix critical and important issues before continuing to later work.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a vague review without requirements or a revision range.
Do not treat a positive assessment as a substitute for running tests.
Do not dismiss important feedback without technical evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill help review?
faq.answer: It helps review completed code changes against requirements, tests, architecture, and production readiness.

faq.question: Does it run the code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a review workflow and template that an AI agent can use with repository context.

faq.question: Why does it ask for base and head revisions?
faq.answer: The revisions define the exact change range so the reviewer can focus on relevant work.

faq.question: Can it replace human code review?
faq.answer: No. It supports human reviewers by finding issues early and organizing feedback clearly.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How should teams handle reviewer feedback?
faq.answer: Fix critical and important issues first, record minor issues, and challenge incorrect feedback with evidence.
